experiments.scope: H1, H5 (proof.md Sections 5, 9, 13.1 and 13.3). Trials 0..5 run the counted online program on seed-drawn first blocks (two uniform words from SHAKE-256 of the seed per first block; real 38-step compressions) until a first block has a passing class (at most 64 first blocks), processing its first passing class completely (24,576 good pairs, 3 stage-1 and 96 stage-2 programs): the stage-3a decision of every lane is compared with the scalar definition (E16x = C16 + W0 + s0(W1) from the Step-2 equations), every passing lane's a0 with the class member, the hit list of all 8 W7 tests with the definition of F7, and 8 good pairs are checked against rows -4..15. Trials 6..13 run the 3 stage-1 programs and all 96 stage-2 programs of class t - 6 on a seed-drawn first block and compare all 24,576 lanes with the scalar definition, so every one of the 24 stage-1 and 768 stage-2 programs is executed. A trial returns M0||M1 and M0||M1' (128 bytes each) iff all its checks passed. Trials 14..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Full collisions: 0 by design (trials 0..5 return good pairs of rows -4..15 and trials 6..13 the first member of a class on a seed-drawn first block, not collisions). Mismatches: 0. Returned pairs: 14. Observations: first_blocks, w7_classes, classes_processed, good_pairs, prefilter_passes, row16_passes, counted_ops, units, filter_mismatches, cell_mismatches, lane_mismatches, pairs_cell_checked (trials 0..5); class_index, programs, lanes, prefilter_passes, lane_mismatches (trials 6..13). A local emulation of the request returned 14 pairs with 0 mismatches of every kind (147,456 lanes in trials 0..5, 196,608 in trials 6..13). This tests the counted program, the bit-sliced decision of every lane of every stage-2 program run with its stage-1 program (H5), the memory-free F7 test and the Step-2 equations on seeded first blocks (H1); it does not test q3.

experiments.scope: H2 (proof.md Sections 6.1, 7.3, 7.4 and 13.3): an organizer-executed replica of q3 for the accepted event (rows 16..21 with row 19 on its signed differences, equal outputs after step 37) with a pass rule frozen before its calibration. Trials 0..19 are 20 independent replicates of a sequential Monte-Carlo estimator seeded from SHAKE-256 of the trial seed: 64 particles uniform on the 160-word row-16 set; rows 17..21 with 256, 32, 4, 8, 8 proposals per particle (E_t^x with its fixed x-bits and + bits imposed, exact weight 2^-f; row 19: one of two relation sets of 1a695f0b's row-19 conditions, weight 2 x 2^-f), the row and its two-bit conditions checked, multinomial resampling; tail: 48 proposals per particle of a variant uniform on the 196,608 selected ones, W23 uniform in F23 with W7 kept iff in F7 (weight |F23|/|F7|), E22[29] = 0 (weight 1/2), rows 22..37 with an abort at the first differing row, outputs compared. Every success is rebuilt into a 38-step semi-free-start collision, verified and run through the counted program step3b, which must accept it. Replicate trials return their first verified pair (CV1||M1, CV1||M1', 96 bytes each). Trial 20 returns a pair iff the pooled mean of the 20 linear estimates is >= 2^-97.0 and no check failed. Trials 21..255 return no pair by design.
experiments.hypothesis: Pass rule (frozen before the calibration): trial 20 returns a pair, i.e. pooled mean >= 2^-97.0 with 0 failed checks. Returned pairs: 21 (one per replicate with a success and trial 20). They are 96-byte CV1||M1 witnesses, each a 38-step semi-free-start collision from its CV1 (verifiable offline with the 38-step compression), NOT full collisions: the organizer recomputation finds 0 full collisions of the target here, by design. This experiment tests the q3 replica and the counted step3b program, not the complete two-block attack. Observations: log2_estimate, estimate_zero, successes, failed_rebuilds (failed checks, 0), verified_pairs, tail_log2; trial 20: log2_pooled_mean. Calibration (960 replicates, fresh labels, preregistered with the program hash): mean 2^-96.3095, halves -96.332 / -96.287, the 48 pooled means of 20 have mean -96.321, sd 0.185, minimum -96.931, none below the threshold; 3 replicates without a success. Local emulation of the request: 21 pairs, pooled mean 2^-96.158. The replica estimates a lower bound of q3; q3_model is 2^-96.5755.
